challengeSolutions.Reaching younger audiences: TikTok is THE platform to reach Gen Z and Millennials, with 60% of users aged 16-24.
challengeSolutions.Creative fatigue: TikTok's native, authentic content style combats creative fatigue with fresh, engaging formats.
challengeSolutions.Rising CPMs: TikTok offers competitive CPMs with strong performance, helping optimize your media efficiency.
challengeSolutions.Limited reach: With 1B+ monthly active users, TikTok provides massive incremental reach to complement existing channels.
challengeSolutions.Low engagement: TikTok users spend an average of 95 minutes per day on the app—the highest engagement of any platform.
challengeSolutions.Attribution issues: Our advanced measurement solutions including CAPI, Brand Lift, and Conversion Lift provide clear attribution.
challengeSolutions.Competition: Stand out from competitors by being an early mover on TikTok in your vertical.
challengeSolutions.Scaling issues: TikTok's diverse ad formats and broad reach enable efficient scaling of campaigns.
challengeSolutions.Brand perception: Build authentic connections with audiences through native, creator-driven content.
challengeSolutions.New market entry: TikTok's global reach and cultural relevance make it ideal for market expansion.

scenarioMessages.New Product Launch: With a new product launch on the horizon, timing is critical to capture market attention.
scenarioMessages.Geo Expansion: As they expand into new geographic markets, reaching new audiences is essential.
scenarioMessages.Rebrand: With a rebrand underway, this is the perfect moment to reintroduce the brand to audiences.
scenarioMessages.Full Funnel: A full-funnel approach will maximize impact across awareness, consideration, and conversion.
scenarioMessages.Seasonal Campaign: Seasonal moments drive peak consumer intent—perfect timing to maximize TikTok's engaged audiences.
scenarioMessages.Always On: An always-on presence builds sustained brand awareness and keeps the brand top-of-mind.
